decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Drawing Numbers 795/01, 795/02, 795/04, received 16/02/10, 795/03B received 19/04/10, Light Analysis Study received 01/06/10. and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Demoltion of conservatory and the erection of  a single storey side extension with creation of a mezzanine floor to studio flat.
